config_files.notes: UTF-8 without BOM, LF line endings. Lua-style flat key-value table. Primary graphics, ray tracing, and upscaler settings.
UTF-8 without BOM, LF line endings. Contains display resolution, refresh rate, window mode, audio, and input settings.

keys.effect: Depth of field camera blur in gameplay and cinematics.
keys.notes: Set to "Off" when eye_comfort / motion_comfort is active to eliminate optical refocusing strain across ultrawide displays. Set to "High" for couch TV viewing.
Keep false for all profiles. Eliminates eye strain and prevents high-frequency video encoding degradation on game streams.
Keep false for eye comfort to prevent tunnel vision on wide viewing angles.
Keep false for all goals. Primary nausea and visual fatigue trigger.

keys.effect: Anamorphic streaks and cinematic lens flares.
keys.notes: Set to "Off" for eye comfort and streaming clarity.

keys.effect: DLSS 3 / FSR frame generation switch ("2x" or "Off").
keys.notes: Enables 90+ FPS on RTX 40-series cards at 5120x1440. Recommend "Off" for 60Hz Steam Link streaming to avoid input latency and stream packet jitter.
Use DLSS on NVIDIA GeForce RTX GPUs.
Quality renders internally at ~67% per dimension with sharp temporal reconstruction.

keys.effect: In-engine frame rate cap in FPS.
keys.notes: Set to 60 for flat 60Hz Steam Link streaming. Set to 144 for 90FPS+ G-Sync ultrawide play.
Snowdrop engine uses hardware RT for global illumination. Low is optimal for high-res ultrawide 90FPS+; Medium/High can be enabled at 1080p.
Specular RT reflection resolution. Low at 5120x1440; Medium/High at 1080p.

keys.effect: NVIDIA RTX Direct Illumination path tracing.
keys.notes: Extreme compute cost. Keep Off for 90FPS+ targets.

notes: Star Wars: Outlaws runs on Ubisoft Massive's Snowdrop engine using DirectX 12.
Configurations are stored as Lua-style tables in %USERPROFILE%\Documents\My Games\Outlaws\.
Saved strictly as UTF-8 without BOM with LF line endings.
Ray tracing is baked into the Snowdrop rendering pipeline; RTXDI should remain Off for high frame-rate stability.
For Steam Link or remote play, set windowMode = "Borderless" in state.cfg and cap customFPSLimit = 60 to prevent encoder stutter.
Eye comfort profile disables Motion Blur, Chromatic Aberration, Vignette, Depth of Field, and Lens Cinematic Effects.
